Dietary modiﬁcation alone may be insufﬁcient and supplementary pharmacological intervention may be required to achieve
a satisfactory therapeutic outcome. Guar, acarbose and miglitol, which slow glucose absorption and decrease the insulinemic
response to food, may be effective. When these medications fail to improve the symptoms, somatostatin analogs which reduce
